name: Salucians (11 AP)
body:
These beings are thin, long-limbed, three-fingered, and their legs are digitigrade. They have thin, elongated heads with large eyes with eyelids that close from below. Their skin and eyes come in a wide array of colors. There is no discernible dimorphic difference between male and female salucians.

They have a fast metabolism, so they eat many small meals and need about 1 hour of sleep to equal a typical 8-hour sleep for other ancestries. This however means they live much shorter life-spans than other ancestries.

Salucians love developing technology and learning new things and generally abhor violence.

Relations: Salucians are cordial with other ancestries, but jealously guard any knowledge and technology they may have unless they get worthy payment. This can make some relations strained, but their discoveries are so useful that most will put up with even the most arrogant salucian. Salucians also deem spycraft as a normal course of actions with other species and spend a fair amount of time and resources on it.

Alignment and Religion: Salucians tend to be regimented in their thinking and stray closer to lawful alignments and they ?worship? knowledge over any other outside force they would be beholden.

Adventurers: Salucian adventurers are rare, but the typical reason is to seek knowledge by experience, discovery, or spying.

Standard Ancestral Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Salucians have an incredible memory and intellect but are physically frail. They gain a +4 Intelligence but a -2 Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. (1 AP)
Size: Salucians are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size. (0 AP)
Type: Salucians are Humanoids with the salucian subtype. (0 AP)
Base Speed: Salucians have a base speed of 30 feet. (0 AP)
Languages: Salucians begin play speaking salucian and one other language of their choice. Salucians with high Intelligence scores can choose from any non-secret language. (1 AP)
Defensive Ancestral Traits
Illusion Resistance: Salucians gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusion spells or effects. (1 AP)
Feat and Skill Ancestral Traits
Tinkerer: Salucians gain a +2 racial bonus on all Craft or Profession checks. (2 AP)
Superior Memory: Salucians gain a +2 racial bonus on two Knowledge skills of their choice. Alternatively, they can swap one Knowledge skill for two Lore skills. (4 AP)
Senses Ancestral Traits
Darkvision: Salucians can see in the dark up to 60 feet. (2 AP)
Alternative Ancestral Traits
Device Tinkering: Some salucians focus on modifying engineering instead of creating. They gain a +1 bonus on Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering) checks. Knowledge (engineering) is always a class skill for them. Salucians can take this trait in place of tinkerer.
Gifted Linguist: Some salucians eschew tinkering for a focus on learning the languages of other cultures to better understand them and learn from them. Salucians can take this trait in place of tinkerer.
Skilled: Some salucians are more varied in their skills. They gain an additional skill rank at 1st level and one additional skill rank whenever they gain a level. Salucians can take this trait in place of superior memory.
Spycraft: Some salucians will resort to spying and subterfuge to gain more information and discoveries. They gain a +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and Bluff and Disguise become class skills for them. If they have a class that has those skills as class skills, they may use their Intelligence in place of their Charisma for those skills. Salucians can take this trait in place of superior memory.
Subtle: Some salucians are more willing to believe what they see and are thus more approachable. They gain a +1 bonus on Bluff, Disguise, and Knowledge (local) checks. Salucians can take this trait in place of illusion resistance.
